title: Frontend: Empty states for all major list views
description: Create reusable empty state components and implement them across all list views: projects, milestones, todos, journal, parking lot, timeline, notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Reusable EmptyState component with icon, title, description, and optional CTA button
Used in: Projects dashboard, Milestones tab, Todos tab, Journal tab, Parking Lot tab, Timeline tab, Notifications dropdown
Each empty state has contextually appropriate message and CTA
Verify in browser using Playwright (set up each empty state)

steps.details: Create src/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx. Props: icon (Lucide React component), title, description, action?: { label, onClick }. Render centered with icon (large, muted), title (muted foreground), description, and optional Button.

Projects: 'No projects yet — Create your first project'. Milestones: 'No milestones — Add a milestone to track your goals'. Todos: 'No todos — Add tasks to track your work'. Journal: 'No entries yet — Log your first update'. Parking Lot: 'No ideas yet — Add ideas you want to explore later'. Timeline: 'No activity yet — Start working on your project'. Notifications: 'All caught up!'.
Create a project with no milestones/todos. Open each tab and verify appropriate empty state renders with correct message.
